Tactics after Rd5 give Black a winning bind: White cannot untangle without dropping material, and Black maintains mating threats on the second rank.
Re1+ looks tempting but likely fails to Rxe1, trading off Black’s attacking rook and diffusing the initiative. I recommend Rd5.
